why: Ten more country deep dives (Indonesia, Pakistan, Türkiye, Bangladesh, Iran, Mexico, Egypt, Poland, Nigeria, Thailand), each from its own registry, payer and regulator sources with the gaps named, after an accuracy pass of 1,887 claims

Search finds things sooner and says when it is loading: a small names-first index (first result 5.6 s instead of 11.9 s on slow 3G), a visible loading state, exact names ranked first, and the palette bug that hid good matches below the fold fixed
The machines page gathers its families from the records, so all 106 machine types appear (seven were missing) and each family links its chain of development

Searches that find nothing can start research: an anonymous search-miss event, sent only with consent for name-like queries after a filter that drops personal details, never published; the privacy page says so
